lead.purpose: The prominent number — class time on a card (20px bold, tight tracking).

title.purpose: Card titles / class type (18px semibold, snug tracking).

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels — status chips, day separators (12px semibold, wide tracking).

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation of class cards and the active toggle pill — a whisper of lift confirming the hairline border.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Genuinely floating surfaces (sheets/menus); not used at rest on the schedule.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one confident crimson action per view (e.g. Book Class).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #E23B4E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_600SemiBold', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #C82F41; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive/blocking action (Cancel Booking) — outlined deeper red, distinct from the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #B3261E; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #B3261E; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_600SemiBold', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover, .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #FBEAE8; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary neutral action (Join Waitlist) — hairline-outlined ink on white.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #DCDCDC; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1A1A; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_600SemiBold', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover, .ds-btn-quiet:active { background: #F0F0F0; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Selection chip rail. Active = filled crimson pill (the one place selection earns the accent); idle = hairline-outlined on white.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_600SemiBold', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-active { background: #E23B4E; border-color: #E23B4E; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip-idle { background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #DCDCDC; color: #5C5C5C; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Quiet filled-wash state pill; text tints from the fill's hue. Tones: open (green), accent/booked (crimson), full (danger), lifecycle (neutral).
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_600SemiBold', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-open { background: #EAF3EE; color: #2F7D5B; } .ds-status-accent { background: #FDECEE; color: #C82F41; } .ds-status-danger { background: #FBEAE8; color: #B3261E; } .ds-status-neutral { background: #F0F0F0; color: #5C5C5C; }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Week/Day toggle. Active segment is a white lifted pill on a sunken track — selection reads through elevation + weight, not the accent.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; background: #F0F0F0; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-seg-item { flex: 1; height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_500Medium', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #8A8A8A; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-active { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1A1A; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_600SemiBold', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0px 1px 3px rgba(26,26,26,0.05); }

components.name: Class Card
components.description: The signature schedule card: lead time + class type, quiet metadata rows with drawn icons, a status chip, and one action.
components.html:
6:00 – 7:00 AM
CrossFit
OPEN
8 / 12 spots
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E8E8E8; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; box-shadow: 0px 1px 3px rgba(26,26,26,0.05); } .ds-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-card-time { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_700Bold', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.4px; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-card-type { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_600SemiBold', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.2px; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk_400Regular', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #5C5C5C; }

narrative.overview: A booking app that feels calm and effortless, not a proof-of-concept. The whole system rests on monochrome discipline plus one confident accent: near-black ink on a white and near-white ground does about 95% of the work, and a single muted crimson does the rest. Neutrals carry structure and hierarchy; the accent is rationed so hard that when it appears — on the one primary action, the active filter, a held spot — it means something. This is an Operate-mode system: scanability, consistency, and native task affordances outrank expression. Brand does not live in decoration; it lives in precise details — the single accent, the type ramp, the 4pt spacing rhythm, the hairline structure, and the drawn icon set. The system is a role layer (constants/design.ts), not a palette dump: every token has exactly one job.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome base carried by neutrals; one rationed crimson accent.
Destructive/urgent uses a distinct deeper red, never the accent.
Selection reads through elevation + weight, not color.
One self-hosted grotesk (Hanken Grotesk); no serif/system clash.
Drawn Ionicons behind semantic names; zero emoji as UI.
Smooth rounded cards, hairline structure, restrained real-offset elevation.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Crimson (#E23B4E) appears in exactly three places: the primary CTA, the active filter chip, and selection. If a fourth use appears on a screen, it is wrong. The accent is a signal; its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: The accent and destructive red are never the same value. Confident/positive actions use crimson (#E23B4E); destructive/blocking states use the deeper danger red (#B3261E). They must not blur into each other.

rules.name: The Same-Hue Chip Rule
rules.body: Status-chip text tints from the same hue as its fill (green-on-green, crimson-on-crimson wash), never a flat gray on a colored wash.

rules.name: The Named-Face Rule
rules.body: Never style weight with fontWeight alone. Always route text through the Text primitive with a semantic weight; the family is what actually selects the face on native.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Structure and separation come from hairline borders and tonal grounds first; a card shadow only confirms the lift. If a border and a shadow both fight to separate the same edge, keep the hairline.

dos: Do import every value from constants/design.ts roles (Ink, Ground, Line, Accent, Status, Type, Radius, Space, Elevation). Use the role, not the hex.
Do route all text through the Text primitive with a semantic size, weight, and tone; let it pick the correct Hanken Grotesk family.
Do keep crimson to the primary CTA, the active filter chip, and selection (The One Accent Rule).
Do use the deeper danger red (#B3261E) for destructive/blocking states and keep it visually distinct from the accent (The Two Reds Rule).
Do convey toggle selection through elevation + weight (white lifted pill), not color.
Do separate surfaces with hairlines and tonal grounds first; let the card shadow only confirm the lift (The Hairline-First Rule).
Do add new icons to the Icon name map (Ionicons outline) rather than reaching for a glyph inline.
donts: Don't write raw hex in a component — always reference a design-token role.
Don't let the accent spread into a fourth use or become a fill/large surface.
Don't style weight with fontWeight alone; on native it will silently render the regular face.
Don't use emoji (👥 📍 👤 📅 🕐) or gray-square placeholders as UI icons.
Don't put a flat, blurry drop-shadow halo on surfaces; elevation is a real offset with a soft ink-tinted blur.
Don't reintroduce the legacy constants/theme.ts grays/blues/greens on a restyled screen (it survives only for not-yet-migrated surfaces).
